profile_pipeline_with_callback: profile a PipelineConfig with a callback to collect ProfileResult stats for each pipe stage
fetch_inputs_from_source: fetch a specified number of input items from a SourceConfig using _fetch_inputs
profile_pipeline_with_custom_hook: profile a pipeline using a custom ProfileHook to instrument stage and pipeline profiling
profile_pipeline_with_merge: profile a PipelineConfig that uses Merge to combine multiple sub-pipelines and profile all stages
build_pipeline_config_for_profiling: build a PipelineConfig with Pipe, Aggregate, and Disaggregate stages for profiling with profile_pipeline
